operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: conventions (amount, date, currency, category) and ready-to-run recipes for receipts, bank CSV files, summaries and fixes.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: Home currency, its decimals, and the monthly budget.

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change the home currency (amounts keep their value) and/or the overall monthly budget (0 removes it).

currency.description: New home currency, ISO code e.g. EUR

monthly_budget.description: Overall monthly budget in major units; 0 removes it

currency_confirmed.description: Mark the currency as chosen by the user

operations.name: summary.month
operations.description: Month overview: total, count, daily totals, per-category totals and budgets, overall budget left, biggest expenses, and last month up to the same day.

operations.name: summary.trend
operations.description: Monthly totals for the last N months and their average.

operations.name: expenses.list
operations.description: Find expenses, newest first, with the total of all matches. Filter by month or a date range, category, uncategorized, text in the note, source, or having a receipt.

has_receipt.description: Only expenses with a receipt file

operations.name: expenses.get
operations.description: One expense, with its receipt (file path and URL) when it has one.

operations.name: expenses.add
operations.description: Record one expense. Optionally attach the receipt file it came from (receipt_path). Returns the stored expense: check it.

amount.description: Amount in major units, plain number with '.' decimal and no thousands separators, e.g. 12.50

note.description: What it was for or where, e.g. 'Lunch at Ichiran'

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

currency.description: ISO currency code when not the home currency (converted at that day's rate: ECB via Frankfurter, else currency-api)

rate.description: Home currency per 1 unit of `currency`, only when no rate can be had from the rate services

receipt_path.description: Absolute path of the receipt image or PDF to store with it

skip_if_duplicate.description: Return the existing expense instead when one with the same date, amount and note exists

operations.name: expenses.add-many
operations.description: Record many expenses at once (all or nothing: one invalid item writes nothing). Duplicates already stored are skipped by default.

items.description: JSON list of {amount, date, note, category, currency, rate}

skip_duplicates.description: Skip items whose date, amount and note are already stored (default true)

operations.name: expenses.update
operations.description: Change an expense's amount, date, note or category.

amount.description: Amount in major units, plain number with '.' decimal and no thousands separators, e.g. 12.50

currency.description: ISO currency code when not the home currency (converted at that day's rate: ECB via Frankfurter, else currency-api) (needs amount)

rate.description: Home currency per 1 unit of `currency`, only when no rate can be had from the rate services

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

operations.name: expenses.delete
operations.description: Delete one expense (and its receipt).

operations.name: expenses.delete-many
operations.description: Delete several expenses (and their receipts). All ids must exist or nothing is deleted.

operations.name: expenses.set-category
operations.description: Put several expenses in one category (empty category = uncategorized).

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

operations.name: expenses.attach-receipt
operations.description: Attach a receipt file to an existing expense (replaces its old receipt).

path.description: Absolute path of the image or PDF

operations.name: expenses.remove-receipt
operations.description: Remove an expense's receipt file (the expense stays).

operations.name: categories.list
operations.description: All categories with expense counts, use in the last 90 days, this month's spend and budget.

operations.name: categories.add
operations.description: Create a category.

budget.description: Monthly budget in major units (0 = none)

operations.name: categories.update
operations.description: Rename a category, change its icon or its monthly budget (0 removes it).

budget.description: Monthly budget in major units (0 = none)

operations.name: categories.delete
operations.description: Delete a category; its expenses move to move_to (or become uncategorized).

move_to.description: Category that receives its expenses; empty = uncategorized

operations.name: receipts.list
operations.description: Receipts and their state: waiting (for the agent), reading, done (has its expense) or failed. Each has file_path to read.

operations.name: receipts.get
operations.description: One receipt with its absolute file_path and its expense when done.

operations.name: receipts.add
operations.description: Queue a receipt file for reading (state waiting; the agent is asked to read it).

path.description: Absolute path of the receipt image or PDF

operations.name: receipts.start
operations.description: Mark a receipt as being read (state reading). Always finish it with receipts.complete or receipts.fail: one left reading is marked failed once you stop calling the app.

operations.name: receipts.complete
operations.description: Create the expense a receipt shows and mark the receipt done. Safe to repeat: a receipt only ever gets one expense.

amount.description: TOTAL paid (after tax, tip, discounts). Amount in major units, plain number with '.' decimal and no thousands separators, e.g. 12.50

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

currency.description: Currency printed on the receipt when not the home currency

rate.description: Home currency per 1 unit of `currency`, only when no rate can be had from the rate services

operations.name: receipts.fail
operations.description: Mark a receipt unreadable, with the reason shown to the user.

reason.description: Why it could not be read, e.g. 'too blurry to read the total'

operations.name: receipts.retry
operations.description: Put a failed or stuck receipt back in the queue and ask the agent again.

operations.name: receipts.delete
operations.description: Delete a receipt file (an expense made from it stays, without the file).

operations.name: import.preview
operations.description: Read a bank or card CSV and show what would be imported: detected columns and mapping, counts (new, duplicate, not_expense = money in, empty, invalid) and the first rows. Nothing is written. Repeat with --import_id and options to adjust.

path.description: Absolute path of the CSV file (first call)

import_id.description: Import id from an earlier preview

date_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

amount_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column. Money OUT (with separate debit and credit columns, the debit one)

note_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

category_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

expenses_are.description: Which amounts are spending: negative (income is positive), positive, or all

currency.description: Currency of the file when not the home currency

rate.description: Home currency per 1 unit of `currency`, only when no rate can be had from the rate services. Remembered with the preview, so import.run converts at it too; auto = look the day rate up again

create_categories.description: Create categories named in the category column that do not exist (default true)

show.description: How many planned rows to return (default 50)

operations.name: import.run
operations.description: Import the previewed CSV (same mapping unless an option changes it). Returns how many were added and why others were skipped.

path.description: Or an absolute CSV path to import directly with detected settings

date_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

amount_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

note_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

category_column.description: Column index (0-based) or exact header name; 'none' for no column

currency.description: Currency of the file when not the home currency

rate.description: Home currency per 1 unit of `currency`, only when no rate can be had from the rate services. Remembered with the preview, so import.run converts at it too; auto = look the day rate up again

operations.name: import.list
operations.description: Past CSV imports with how many rows were added and skipped.

operations.name: import.undo
operations.description: Remove every expense an import added.

operations.name: export.csv
operations.description: Expenses in a date range as CSV text (Date, Amount, Currency, Category, Note, Added by, Original amount, Original currency).

from.description: First day YYYY-MM-DD (default first of this month)

operations.name: recurring.list
operations.description: Recurring expenses (rent, subscriptions) with their next date.

operations.name: recurring.add
operations.description: Add a recurring expense. It records itself on each due date; dates already past are added now.

amount.description: Amount in major units, plain number with '.' decimal and no thousands separators, e.g. 12.50

start_date.description: Next (or first) charge date YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

operations.name: recurring.update
operations.description: Change a recurring expense; a new cadence or start_date restarts its schedule from that date. active=false pauses it.

amount.description: Amount in major units, plain number with '.' decimal and no thousands separators, e.g. 12.50

category.description: Existing category name (case ignored) or id; empty = uncategorized

operations.name: recurring.delete
operations.description: Delete a recurring expense (expenses it already added stay).

operations.name: recurring.run-due
operations.description: Add any recurring expenses that are due now (also runs by itself every hour).

operations.name: fx.rate
operations.description: Exchange rate between two currencies on a day (ECB via Frankfurter, else currency-api; `source` says which), and optionally an amount converted.
